# Alcoa Turns Raw Potential into Real Progress

Building a Legacy of Excellence for Future Generations

## Inspired by our vision and guided by our values

### Creating Impact

Our vision is to build a legacy of excellence for future generations. We’ll realize this vision by
running the safest and most reliable operations in the industry while growing our people and shaping
the future. We're turning today's work into a stronger future - not just for Alcoa, but for the
industry and world we help build.

video

Please enable *targeting cookies* to watch videos. You can enable targeting cookies on our [Cookie
Policy page][60].

### Our Commitment

Every day, you’ll find us striving to protect the safety and health of our global workforce and our
environment. We actively engage with our stakeholders in the communities where we operate. We are
focused on not just today, but tomorrow as well - for the people and communities who come next.

### Our People

From purposeful career development and inclusive and diverse work teams, Alcoa employees turn raw
potential into real progress. Today, we continue to channel the determination that first launched an
industry. We’re leading with the same boldness that shaped our history - and setting a new standard
that others will look to for generations.

## Alcoa Worldview

### Alcoa Australia’s Environmental Symposium Shines Light on World-Leading Research

Alcoa Australia’s Environmental Symposium saw 150 people from 34 organisations converge at Murdoch
University for some meaningful conversation.

Read More

### Alcoa, Port of Trois Rivières Inaugurate New Port Facilities Dedicated to Unloading Raw
### Materials for Deschambault Smelter

Alcoa and the Trois Rivières Port Authority (TRPA) officially inaugurated today Alcoa’s new
facilities at Wharf 17, marking an important milestone in the long-standing collaboration between
the two organizations.

Read More

### Alcoa Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report

On World Environment Day, Alcoa released its 2025 Sustainability Report, outlining the Company’s
approach to environmental, social and governance (ESG) topics and the progress made throughout the
year across its global operations.

We mine, process and sell industrial minerals at locations worldwide, focused primarily on silica,
clays, feldspathics and olivine. We are also leaders in glass recycling.

## Who we are

### 
### About Sibelco

Founded in 1872, we have grown into a multinational business with operations in 31 countries and an
extensive multi-mineral portfolio. We work across a broad range of industries, anticipating and
meeting our customers’ changing needs with innovative solutions that combine high-specification
materials and dedicated technical support.

Everything we do is guided by our purpose:* material solutions advancing life*. Our products help to
build homes, cities and vehicles; to support the supply of renewable energy, food and clean water;
to create technologies such as smartphone display screens, printed circuit boards and
semiconductors.

We do this within a robust sustainability framework, always balancing economic performance with
environmental stewardship and social responsibility.

# Industrial Mineral Manufacturer

AGSCO is a leading manufacturer and distributor of a variety of industrial chemicals and abrasives,
minerals and blasting equipment.  We provide minerals such as [silica sand][191], [pool
plasters][192], [mil-spec. materials][193], and more for a variety of different applications. We
also supply a wide range of aggregates for coating removal and surface preparation. Our team of
specialists are available to assist you in choosing the best material for your application. [Contact
us][194] today for more information!

🔗

### Full-chain sourcing support

We coordinate product selection, quality checkpoints, packaging, and export delivery around
industrial buyer requirements.

📋

### Specification-first communication

Discussions are organized around chemistry, sizing, bulk density, and application fit to reduce
decision friction.

⚙️

### Flexible customization

We support custom grain sizes, packing formats, and sourcing combinations based on real project
needs.

🚢

### Stable delivery planning

From quotation to shipment, we keep lead-time and order coordination practical for global
procurement teams.

## About

The Atlantic Alumina Company LLC owned alumina refinery in Louisiana is the last remaining operating
alumina manufacturer in the United States.

Commissioned in 1957, the Gramercy refinery began production of smelter grade alumina under Kaiser
Aluminum, has been called Noranda previously and is now called Atlantic Alumina or Atalco.

Our Gramercy operations are located on the east bank of the Mississippi in Louisiana, about 45 miles
west of New Orleans, with direct sea and river access. It is part of Atlantic Alumina with a
dedicated mining operation in Jamaica exclusively supplying the closest bauxite to the United
States.

Employing a direct workforce of approximately 550 the plant has a unique double-digestion and batch
tank design which makes its smelter and chemical grade alumina some of the most efficient and
desirable in the aluminum sector.

We are developing additional high purity and speciality products with diversified energy sources to
provide customers lower carbon supply chains and total transparency.

non-metallurgical or chemical applications, our calcined alumina trihydrate (ATH) is also referred

## Bauxite Mining

Description
Our Mine

Our bauxite is mined from ore bodies on the north coast of Jamaica and transported by haul trucks
and railcars to our facility just above Discovery Bay. It is then partly dried and blended to ensure
customer quality specifications are met before being shipped on Panamax vessels worldwide. Our
bauxite has one of the lowest silica levels of bauxite globally as well as greater than 46%
available alumina.

After our bauxite pits have been certified as “mined out” the area is reshaped through backfilling
and topsoiling in prepared for restoration to more useful and beneficial state such as forestry,
agricultural, water catchment and greenhouse clusters, with over 135 to date.

## Chemical Grade Alumina (CGA)

Description
Common Use

Also known as Non-Metallurgical Grade Alumina, our CGA includes a calcined product, C-70, and a wet
and dry alumina trihydrate.

WH-30 Wet cake is a high purity alumina trihydrate produced by the Bayer process, with the
consistency of damp beach sand.

H-30 is a high purity alumina trihydrate produced by the Bayer process and dried in a fluid bed
dryer. It is a dry free flowing coarse powder.

Atalco's unique crystallization process produces a product (both H30 and WH30) recognized throughout
the industry as one of the most desirable raw materials for grinding. This same process imparts
properties that lead to rapid dissolution in strong acid or strong bases.

### Welcome to Usem

[More about us][39]

U.S. Electrofused Minerals, Inc., (established in 1982) is part of the Curimbaba Group. The
Curimbaba Group is one of the largest producers and distributors of fused oxides in the world.

As representative of Elfusa in the US market, USEM not only distribute Elfusa´s products but also
manufacture industrial minerals grains and powders. **USEM is specialized** in brown, white and pink
fused aluminum oxides, black and green silicon carbides, sintered and activated bauxites. Our
portfolio of industrial minerals includes fused mullite, magnesia alumina spinel, calcium aluminate
cements, and other fused and sintered materials.

# Alcoa Turns Raw Potential into Real Progress

Building a Legacy of Excellence for Future Generations

## Inspired by our vision and guided by our values

### Creating Impact

Our vision is to build a legacy of excellence for future generations. We’ll realize this vision by
running the safest and most reliable operations in the industry while growing our people and shaping
the future. We're turning today's work into a stronger future - not just for Alcoa, but for the
industry and world we help build.

video

Please enable *targeting cookies* to watch videos. You can enable targeting cookies on our [Cookie
Policy page][60].

### Our Commitment

Every day, you’ll find us striving to protect the safety and health of our global workforce and our
environment. We actively engage with our stakeholders in the communities where we operate. We are
focused on not just today, but tomorrow as well - for the people and communities who come next.

### Our People

From purposeful career development and inclusive and diverse work teams, Alcoa employees turn raw
potential into real progress. Today, we continue to channel the determination that first launched an
industry. We’re leading with the same boldness that shaped our history - and setting a new standard
that others will look to for generations.

## Alcoa Worldview

Alcoa Australia’s Environmental Symposium saw 150 people from 34 organisations converge at Murdoch
University for some meaningful conversation.

facilities at Wharf 17, marking an important milestone in the long-standing collaboration between
the two organizations.

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

## Cleveland-Cliffs Awarded 2025 GM Supplier of the Year by General Motors

Cleveland-Cliffs Inc. was named a 2025 GM Supplier of the Year by General Motors at its 34th annual
Supplier of the Year event. Cleveland-Cliffs was the only North American steel producer recognized
this year. This is the ninth time the company has received the award.

[ View Press Release ][47]

## Congressional Steel Caucus Hearing

Lourenco Goncalves, Cliffs Chairman, President & Chief Executive Officer and the Board Chairman of
the American Iron and Steel Institute provided testimony at the Congressional Steel Caucus held on
January 14, 2026.  Mr. Goncalves spoke about the importance of maintaining Section 232 steel tariffs
and fair trade for the steel industry in the United States. 

The Congressional Steel Caucus is a bipartisan group of U.S. Representatives and Senators working to
support the American steel industry, its workers, and its vital role in national security and
infrastructure, advocating through legislation, meetings with officials, and challenging unfair
trade practices.

Read Mr. Goncalves' testimony, [click here][48]

[ Watch Steel Caucus Hearing on YouTube ][49]

## Cleveland-Cliffs Announces POSCO as MoU Counterparty

Cleveland-Cliffs Inc. is pleased to announce that POSCO, Korea’s largest steelmaker and the world’s
third largest steelmaker outside of China, is its strategic partner under the previously disclosed
transformative Memorandum of Understanding. The MoU between the two companies was executed on
September 17, 2025. With the recent completion of the new U.S. and Korea trade agreement,
cooperation between the two nations’ industrial sectors will be further reinforced by the
POSCO-Cliffs partnership.

Read more in the complete News Release.

[ Read News Release ][50]

## Steel Tariffs

The United States’ steel tariffs continue to play a vital role in supporting the long-term strength,
stability, and competitiveness of the domestic steel industry. In 2025, President Trump restored the
effectiveness of steel Section 232 tariffs by increasing the tariff rate from 25% to 50%, completely
eliminating exclusions and exemptions that had drastically weakened the measures and adding Section
232 tariff coverage of certain steel  derivative products. Trade measures such as Section 232
tariffs are essential to countering persistent global steel overcapacity and unfair trade practices
that distort markets and undermine U.S. producers. These tariff measures help ensure that America
maintains a reliable domestic steel supply critical to sustain U.S. national security.

There are early indications of positive impact, including moderated import pressure and improved
conditions for domestic production. Full year 2025 finished steel imports were down 17% vs. 2024.
However, the full benefits of these tariffs will take time to be fully realized. Steelmaking is a
capital-intensive, long-cycle industry, and meaningful gains in capacity utilization, reinvestment,
and workforce development occur gradually.

## CNBC Invest in America Forum

Lourenco Goncalves, Cleveland-Cliffs Chairman, President & CEO participated at the CNBC Invest in
America Forum. Moderated by Sara Eisen, CNBC Anchor, the panel discussion was about fostering
economic growth and innovation, revitalizing the consumer and supply chains. Joining Lourenco was
Ana Botin, Santander Executive Chairman and John Furner, Walmart U.S. President. To view the panel
discussion, view the video below.

# We are a global material solutions company

We mine, process and sell industrial minerals at locations worldwide, focused primarily on silica,
clays, feldspathics and olivine. We are also leaders in glass recycling.

Scroll down

## Who we are

### 
### About Sibelco

Founded in 1872, we have grown into a multinational business with operations in 31 countries and an
extensive multi-mineral portfolio. We work across a broad range of industries, anticipating and
meeting our customers’ changing needs with innovative solutions that combine high-specification
materials and dedicated technical support.

Everything we do is guided by our purpose:* material solutions advancing life*. Our products help to
build homes, cities and vehicles; to support the supply of renewable energy, food and clean water;
to create technologies such as smartphone display screens, printed circuit boards and
semiconductors.

We do this within a robust sustainability framework, always balancing economic performance with
environmental stewardship and social responsibility.

# Industrial Mineral Manufacturer

AGSCO is a leading manufacturer and distributor of a variety of industrial chemicals and abrasives,
minerals and blasting equipment.  We provide minerals such as [silica sand][191], [pool
plasters][192], [mil-spec. materials][193], and more for a variety of different applications. We
also supply a wide range of aggregates for coating removal and surface preparation. Our team of
specialists are available to assist you in choosing the best material for your application. [Contact
us][194] today for more information!

[Minerals and Abrasives]

### Minerals and Abrasives

We carry a full line of industrial grade minerals & abrasives for a variety of applications and
industries.

[Learn More][195]
[Equipment]

### Equipment

We carry a full line of blasting equipment for your existing blasting operation or if you're looking
to get started in the business.

[Learn More][196]
[Custom Services]

### Custom Services

We provide a full line of custom mineral processing and toll services, including precise screening,
blending, coating, and private labeling.

# Calcined Alumina and Alumina-based Products

## A team of skilled personnel equipped with the best equipment

[[Calcined Alumina (α-Alumina)][Calcined Alumina (α-Alumina)]][126]
[[Reactive-Alumina][Reactive-Alumina]][127]
[[Aluminium-Hydroxide][Aluminium-Hydroxide]][128]
**ALPHA** is a trustworthy brand for manufacturing high-quality and diverse calcined alumina and
alumina-based products. Producing calcined alumina products in a wide variety of chemical
compositions, particle size distribution and physical properties which are trusted by our customers
is our goal. Precision in production, never-ending research and development and reliable customer
support are our core principles that ensure our customers choose us for their needs.
* **Calcined Alumina (α-Alumina): ** refractory, polishing, engobes and glazes, catalysts, high
  voltage insulation, filters, grinding media, honeycomb ceramics, etc.
* **Reactive Alumina: ** Low, ultra-low and No cement castables, Gunning and shotcrete mixes,
  Nozzles, lances, purging sets, sleeves, etc.
* **Aluminum Hydroxide (ATH): ** Flame retardants filler for wire coatings, construction materials,
  Light materials in the automotive industry, etc.

For quality, consistency, and our customers’ trust!

# Calcined Alumina and Alumina-based Products

## A team of skilled personnel equipped with the best equipment

[[Calcined Alumina (α-Alumina)][Calcined Alumina (α-Alumina)]][126]
[[Reactive-Alumina][Reactive-Alumina]][127]
[[Aluminium-Hydroxide][Aluminium-Hydroxide]][128]
**ALPHA** is a trustworthy brand for manufacturing high-quality and diverse calcined alumina and
alumina-based products. Producing calcined alumina products in a wide variety of chemical
compositions, particle size distribution and physical properties which are trusted by our customers
is our goal. Precision in production, never-ending research and development and reliable customer
support are our core principles that ensure our customers choose us for their needs.
* **Calcined Alumina (α-Alumina): ** refractory, polishing, engobes and glazes, catalysts, high
  voltage insulation, filters, grinding media, honeycomb ceramics, etc.
* **Reactive Alumina: ** Low, ultra-low and No cement castables, Gunning and shotcrete mixes,
  Nozzles, lances, purging sets, sleeves, etc.
* **Aluminum Hydroxide (ATH): ** Flame retardants filler for wire coatings, construction materials,
  Light materials in the automotive industry, etc.

For quality, consistency, and our customers’ trust!

ALPHA

## APPLICATIONS:

[ ][129]

### Shaped Refractories

Shaped Refractories like bricks, blocks, liners, nozzles, orifices and tiles need different grades
of calcined alumina for their application in furnaces, boilers, crucibles and etc. ALPHA products
meet Shaped Refractories requirements with precision.
[ ][130]

### Unshaped Refractories

Castables, refractory plastics, ramming material, gunning mix, refractory clay and any other types
of unshaped refractories are in dire need of different kinds of alumina-based materials. ALPHA
offers a wide variety of products suitable for these applications.
[ ][131]

### Technical Ceramics

Lots of technical ceramics like catalyst supports, honeycomb ceramics, filters, grinding media, etc.
require suitable material for achieving desired properties. ALPHA offers different grades of
calcined alumina and alumina-based materials ideal for producing these ceramic bodies.
[ ][132]

### Standard Ceramics

By producing alumina products in various specific surface areas and size distributions ALPHA
provides different grades of calcined alumina ideal for manufacturing standard ceramics.
[ ][133]

### Polishing

By producing calcined alumina in precise purity and size distribution, ALPHA provides different
grades of polishing materials for every industrial polishing need.
[ ][134]

### Flame Retardant

Lots of industries like construction, cables and wires, automotive, etc. require high amounts of
non-toxic flame retardant filler. Alpha offers different grades of aluminum hydroxide (ATH) as an
excellent flame-retardant filler for polymers.

## About

The Atlantic Alumina Company LLC owned alumina refinery in Louisiana is the last remaining operating
alumina manufacturer in the United States.

Commissioned in 1957, the Gramercy refinery began production of smelter grade alumina under Kaiser
Aluminum, has been called Noranda previously and is now called Atlantic Alumina or Atalco.

Our Gramercy operations are located on the east bank of the Mississippi in Louisiana, about 45 miles
west of New Orleans, with direct sea and river access. It is part of Atlantic Alumina with a
dedicated mining operation in Jamaica exclusively supplying the closest bauxite to the United
States.

Employing a direct workforce of approximately 550 the plant has a unique double-digestion and batch
tank design which makes its smelter and chemical grade alumina some of the most efficient and
desirable in the aluminum sector.

We are developing additional high purity and speciality products with diversified energy sources to
provide customers lower carbon supply chains and total transparency.

## Products

## Smelter Grade Alumina (SGA)

Description
Common Use

Our SGA is a high purity alumina, low in iron and zinc, made by calcining the alumina trihydrate
(ATH) produced by the Bayer process in natural gas fired rotary kilns at approximately 1500F.

[
Enquire
[Arrow Right]
][23]

In addition to the feedstock for aluminum smelters, refractories, abrasives, ceramics and production
of commodity grade P1020 aluminum metal, our SGA is particularly effective for the production of
higher purity grades of aluminum as used in the aerospace, military and automotive sectors. For
non-metallurgical or chemical applications, our calcined alumina trihydrate (ATH) is also referred
to as C-70 calcined alumina.

[

## Products

## Bauxite Mining

Description
Our Mine

Our bauxite is mined from ore bodies on the north coast of Jamaica and transported by haul trucks
and railcars to our facility just above Discovery Bay. It is then partly dried and blended to ensure
customer quality specifications are met before being shipped on Panamax vessels worldwide. Our
bauxite has one of the lowest silica levels of bauxite globally as well as greater than 46%
available alumina.

After our bauxite pits have been certified as “mined out” the area is reshaped through backfilling
and topsoiling in prepared for restoration to more useful and beneficial state such as forestry,
agricultural, water catchment and greenhouse clusters, with over 135 to date.

[
Enquire
[Arrow Right]
][25]
* is 51% owned by the Government of Jamaica;
* only mines 15% of its mining leases;
* plants many more trees (over 100,000 a year) than it removes; never mines in forestry or protected
  areas;
* pays approximately US$80,000,000 a year into Jamaica;
* provides direct and indirect employment for over 1500 Jamaicans***;***
* does not require any crushing or grinding of the bauxite at either the mine or the refinery.

## Future Products

Description
Common Use

At least 15 of the Defense Logistic Agency’s 46 strategic & critical materials are present in the
refinery's wet and dry stacked tailings, including 10 of the 17 Rare Earth Elements (REE) at
extractable grades.

The 5 critical minerals include: Aluminum Oxide (Al2O3), Gallium (Ga), Strontium (Sr),
Niobium/Columbium (Nb) and Nickel (Ni); and the REE include: Scandium (Sc), Neodymium (Nd),
Dysprosium (Dy), Praseodymium (Pr), Lanthanum (La), Lutetium (Lu), Samarium ( Sm ), Erbium Er ),
Gadolinium ( Gd ) and Cerium (Ce).

This gives Atalco an opportunity to be a large part of the nation’s solution to onshoring supply of
these materials, critical to our national & economic defense.

How do I select the right Aluminium Hydroxide grade?

The grade should be selected according to particle size, processing method, flame retardant
requirement and compatibility with the polymer system.

How do I choose Calcined Alumina for ceramics?

Consider Al₂O₃ purity, Na₂O content, α-Al₂O₃ phase, D50 particle size, firing temperature and final
ceramic performance.

Can Detopalu recommend a product based on our formulation?

Yes. Provide your application, current formulation, required particle size and performance target
for grade recommendation.

Are low-soda Calcined Alumina grades available?

Yes. Low-soda grades are available for electronic ceramics, advanced ceramics and applications
requiring tighter impurity control.

What packaging options are available?

Standard options include 25 kg bags, palletized packaging and jumbo bags. Customized export
packaging can also be discussed.

Can we request samples and technical data?

Yes. TDS documents and samples can be provided according to the application and requested grade.

# 关于产品

[a2e11f321ce556acfb67dd0ed2a0346.jpg]

自 2003
年成立以来，我们一直致力于为全球耐火材料行业提供高纯度、质量稳定性优异的铝基原材料。我们的生产能力包
括：

・每年 12 万吨的板状刚玉，

・每年 5 万吨的白刚玉，

・每年 5 万吨的煅烧活性氧化铝粉，

・每年 2 万吨的高纯烧结尖晶石，

每年 2 万吨的电熔尖晶石，

・每年 1 万吨的富铝尖晶石微粉。

我们还有自主研发的独特产品，如致密六铝酸钙（CA6）、致密二铝酸钙（CA2），以及水硬性结合氧化铝和高分散
性氧化铝等配套产品。

#  

 

[[Services]][60]

### [PRODUCTS][61]

We offer the full range of ceramic powders including silicon carbide, boron carbide, calcined
alumina, aluminum oxide and industrial diamond. We also offer other specialty materials including
cerium oxide, silicon metal and hexagonal boron nitride.

### [APPLICATIONS][62]

Our materials support a broad range of applications and processes. If you are in one of the typical
markets we serve, technical ceramics, surface preparation, specialty fillers, armor, friction
applications and abrasives, let our expertise help you solve your material needs.

 

### [SERVICES][63]

Panadyne can provide custom size materials or meet custom chemistry requirements as required for
your project.

[[Panadyne Story]][64]

### [OUR STORY][65]

Panadyne Inc is an an AS9100 and ISO9001 registered distributor of high quality specialty raw
materials. Started in 2003, we have built upon our foundation in Ceramics Engineering as well as our
35 years of experience in the technical ceramics industry to provide material solutions to all of
our customers.

#  

 

[[Services]][60]

### [PRODUCTS][61]

We offer the full range of ceramic powders including silicon carbide, boron carbide, calcined
alumina, aluminum oxide and industrial diamond. We also offer other specialty materials including
cerium oxide, silicon metal and hexagonal boron nitride.

### [APPLICATIONS][62]

Our materials support a broad range of applications and processes. If you are in one of the typical
markets we serve, technical ceramics, surface preparation, specialty fillers, armor, friction
applications and abrasives, let our expertise help you solve your material needs.

 

### [SERVICES][63]

Panadyne can provide custom size materials or meet custom chemistry requirements as required for
your project.

[[Panadyne Story]][64]

### [OUR STORY][65]

Panadyne Inc is an an AS9100 and ISO9001 registered distributor of high quality specialty raw
materials. Started in 2003, we have built upon our foundation in Ceramics Engineering as well as our
35 years of experience in the technical ceramics industry to provide material solutions to all of
our customers.

## EXCELLENCE IN TECHNOLOGY AND SERVICE

SACMI is an international group, world leader in the supply of advanced technologies for the
Ceramics, Plastics, Food & Beverage, Metals, Packaging and Advanced Materials sectors, thanks to the
application of innovative technologies, its strong positioning on the world markets, and its
continuous search for high quality standards and customer service. 
Continuous investments in Research & Development - 234 million euro in the last 3 years alone -
allow SACMI to offer the market the best state of the art technologies, working alongside the
customer to develop increasingly efficient, competitive and sustainable products and processes.

## SACMI ACADEMY
## The Machine University

An open space at the heart of the SACMI production environment for sharing skills, work tools and
values.
Professional and human values, and over a century of technological expertise combine to produce some
of the very best professionals to be found in today’s manufacturing sector. 
In Italy and abroad.

###  

## SACMI GROUP

The SACMI Group operates globally with over 70 production, distribution and service companies
operating in 25 countries. The SACMI brand and logo are recognised and protected in over 100
countries worldwide. Through its own brands and thanks to the companies of its Global Network,
active in the five continents, SACMI distributes its products and services all over the world,
always putting customer satisfaction first.

[about us][63]

## €1526

billion of revenues in 2025

## 6521

patent applications made

## 4912

employees worldwide

## >70

manufacturing companies

## INNOVATION SINCE 1919

Technological innovation and knowledge represent a considerable asset for SACMI: the distinctive
sign with which the Group operates, in the various sectors of activity, on international markets.
SACMI dedicates great energy and capital to the R&D sector, in order to promote new technological
applications for the improvement and evolution of its range of products.
 

## SUSTAINABILITY

Generating sustainable innovation is the challenge that SACMI has faced by becoming a protagonist of
the circular economy, with solutions aimed at containing the consumption of raw materials and
energy, new technologies and prototypes made possible by the extensive knowledge of materials and
processes. Furthermore, the investments made in recent years have made it possible to greatly reduce
the environmental impact of production activities, containing emissions into the atmosphere,
reducing water consumption and optimizing the waste management cycle.

# Precision. Performance. Partnership.

At The Alumina Company (TAC), we are building a world-class specialty alumina platform at Abu Dhabi.
Our state-of-the-art facility shall produce Specialty Aluminas across six distinct lines with a
combined annual capacity of 300,000 TPY by 2030. The first line for White Fused Alumina goes
onstream in 2026. We fulfill critical applications in refractories, abrasives, technical ceramics,

# Why our platform delivers

Strategically Engineered for Performance, Reliability, and Long-Term Value

# Strategic Location

KEZAD is at the nexus of dependable feedstock, global logistics and green energy. UAE domicile
mitigates impact of taxes and tariffs. Lowest cost delivered at our your plant gate.

# Full Basket Offerings

Complete specialty alumina portfolio: one stop solutions, strategic sourcing, risk diversification
—plug-in architecture for to scale up your operations.

# Advanced Automation

Best-in-class European automation programmed for cost-efficient execution, powered by Industry 4.0.
Real-time data and remote operations deliver faster response times and dependable, error-free
quality you can count on—batch after batch

# Unmatched Product Breadth at Global Scale

TAC shall produce 300,000 TPY Specialty Alumina across six lines starting with WFA now. Products on
the anvil include Calcines, BFA, Tabular Alumina, Calcium Aluminate Cement, Spinel. These lines
shall be at a single location in UAE enabling you to source the full spectrum of your specialty
alumina needs from a single, reliable partner.

# Global Industries. Critical Applications.

We empower industries worldwide with high-performance materials:

## Refractories

High-performance alumina for heat-resistant linings and industrial furnaces.

## Abrasives

Precision materials for cutting, grinding, and polishing applications.

## Technical Ceramics

Advanced alumina for durable, high-precision ceramic components.

# Specialty Alumina Is Everywhere – From Renewables To Wearables

If it’s metal, plastic, brick, or glass, it was made in a refractory system. If it’s smooth, shaped,
or finished, abrasives got it there. From dental implants to the power grid, technical ceramics are
omnipresent. Behind these—plus your phone, your watch, and the critical technologies greening our
planet—specialty alumina quietly powers it all.

Our facility integrates energy-efficient systems, real-time process monitoring, and waste reduction
strategies — minimizing environmental impact while maximizing industrial performance.

TAC has secured two cornerstone long-term partnerships—EGA for feedstock supply and CREMER ERZKONTOR

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

## Cleveland-Cliffs Awarded 2025 GM Supplier of the Year by General Motors

Cleveland-Cliffs Inc. was named a 2025 GM Supplier of the Year by General Motors at its 34th annual
Supplier of the Year event. Cleveland-Cliffs was the only North American steel producer recognized
this year. This is the ninth time the company has received the award.

[ View Press Release ][47]

## Congressional Steel Caucus Hearing

Lourenco Goncalves, Cliffs Chairman, President & Chief Executive Officer and the Board Chairman of
the American Iron and Steel Institute provided testimony at the Congressional Steel Caucus held on
January 14, 2026.  Mr. Goncalves spoke about the importance of maintaining Section 232 steel tariffs
and fair trade for the steel industry in the United States. 

The Congressional Steel Caucus is a bipartisan group of U.S. Representatives and Senators working to
support the American steel industry, its workers, and its vital role in national security and
infrastructure, advocating through legislation, meetings with officials, and challenging unfair
trade practices.

Read Mr. Goncalves' testimony, [click here][48]

[ Watch Steel Caucus Hearing on YouTube ][49]

## Cleveland-Cliffs Announces POSCO as MoU Counterparty

Cleveland-Cliffs Inc. is pleased to announce that POSCO, Korea’s largest steelmaker and the world’s
third largest steelmaker outside of China, is its strategic partner under the previously disclosed
transformative Memorandum of Understanding. The MoU between the two companies was executed on
September 17, 2025. With the recent completion of the new U.S. and Korea trade agreement,
cooperation between the two nations’ industrial sectors will be further reinforced by the
POSCO-Cliffs partnership.

Read more in the complete News Release.

[ Read News Release ][50]

## Steel Tariffs

The United States’ steel tariffs continue to play a vital role in supporting the long-term strength,
stability, and competitiveness of the domestic steel industry. In 2025, President Trump restored the
effectiveness of steel Section 232 tariffs by increasing the tariff rate from 25% to 50%, completely
eliminating exclusions and exemptions that had drastically weakened the measures and adding Section
232 tariff coverage of certain steel  derivative products. Trade measures such as Section 232
tariffs are essential to countering persistent global steel overcapacity and unfair trade practices
that distort markets and undermine U.S. producers. These tariff measures help ensure that America
maintains a reliable domestic steel supply critical to sustain U.S. national security.

There are early indications of positive impact, including moderated import pressure and improved
conditions for domestic production. Full year 2025 finished steel imports were down 17% vs. 2024.
However, the full benefits of these tariffs will take time to be fully realized. Steelmaking is a
capital-intensive, long-cycle industry, and meaningful gains in capacity utilization, reinvestment,
and workforce development occur gradually.

## CNBC Invest in America Forum

Lourenco Goncalves, Cleveland-Cliffs Chairman, President & CEO participated at the CNBC Invest in
America Forum. Moderated by Sara Eisen, CNBC Anchor, the panel discussion was about fostering
economic growth and innovation, revitalizing the consumer and supply chains. Joining Lourenco was
Ana Botin, Santander Executive Chairman and John Furner, Walmart U.S. President. To view the panel
discussion, view the video below.

[ Watch Panel Discussion ][51]

## APPLICATIONS:

[ ][129]

### Shaped Refractories

Shaped Refractories like bricks, blocks, liners, nozzles, orifices and tiles need different grades
of calcined alumina for their application in furnaces, boilers, crucibles and etc. ALPHA products
meet Shaped Refractories requirements with precision.
[ ][130]

### Unshaped Refractories

Castables, refractory plastics, ramming material, gunning mix, refractory clay and any other types
of unshaped refractories are in dire need of different kinds of alumina-based materials. ALPHA
offers a wide variety of products suitable for these applications.
[ ][131]

### Technical Ceramics

Lots of technical ceramics like catalyst supports, honeycomb ceramics, filters, grinding media, etc.
require suitable material for achieving desired properties. ALPHA offers different grades of
calcined alumina and alumina-based materials ideal for producing these ceramic bodies.
[ ][132]

### Standard Ceramics

By producing alumina products in various specific surface areas and size distributions ALPHA
provides different grades of calcined alumina ideal for manufacturing standard ceramics.
[ ][133]

### Polishing

By producing calcined alumina in precise purity and size distribution, ALPHA provides different
grades of polishing materials for every industrial polishing need.
[ ][134]

### Flame Retardant

Lots of industries like construction, cables and wires, automotive, etc. require high amounts of
non-toxic flame retardant filler. Alpha offers different grades of aluminum hydroxide (ATH) as an
excellent flame-retardant filler for polymers.

How do I select the right Aluminium Hydroxide grade?

The grade should be selected according to particle size, processing method, flame retardant
requirement and compatibility with the polymer system.

How do I choose Calcined Alumina for ceramics?

Consider Al₂O₃ purity, Na₂O content, α-Al₂O₃ phase, D50 particle size, firing temperature and final
ceramic performance.

Can Detopalu recommend a product based on our formulation?

Yes. Provide your application, current formulation, required particle size and performance target
for grade recommendation.

Are low-soda Calcined Alumina grades available?

Yes. Low-soda grades are available for electronic ceramics, advanced ceramics and applications
requiring tighter impurity control.

What packaging options are available?

Standard options include 25 kg bags, palletized packaging and jumbo bags. Customized export
packaging can also be discussed.

Can we request samples and technical data?

Yes. TDS documents and samples can be provided according to the application and requested grade.

# 关于产品

[a2e11f321ce556acfb67dd0ed2a0346.jpg]

自 2003
年成立以来，我们一直致力于为全球耐火材料行业提供高纯度、质量稳定性优异的铝基原材料。我们的生产能力包
括：

・每年 12 万吨的板状刚玉，

・每年 5 万吨的白刚玉，

・每年 5 万吨的煅烧活性氧化铝粉，

・每年 2 万吨的高纯烧结尖晶石，

每年 2 万吨的电熔尖晶石，

・每年 1 万吨的富铝尖晶石微粉。

我们还有自主研发的独特产品，如致密六铝酸钙（CA6）、致密二铝酸钙（CA2），以及水硬性结合氧化铝和高分散
性氧化铝等配套产品。

### Our Latest guide:San Francisco

San Francisco is often romanticized for its bridges, hills, and postcard views, but what makes the
city feel so memorable is the deeply local culture woven into everyday life. Beneath the iconic
landmarks is a city shaped by generations of immigrants, artists, musicians, activists, and
independent businesses that continue to give each neighborhood its own distinct identity. Within
just seven square miles, you’ll find historic corner cafes, old bookstores, live music drifting out
of bars, tiny family-run restaurants, and communities that still feel deeply connected to the
rhythms of daily life.

## EXCELLENCE IN TECHNOLOGY AND SERVICE

SACMI is an international group, world leader in the supply of advanced technologies for the
Ceramics, Plastics, Food & Beverage, Metals, Packaging and Advanced Materials sectors, thanks to the
application of innovative technologies, its strong positioning on the world markets, and its
continuous search for high quality standards and customer service. 
Continuous investments in Research & Development - 234 million euro in the last 3 years alone -
allow SACMI to offer the market the best state of the art technologies, working alongside the
customer to develop increasingly efficient, competitive and sustainable products and processes.

## The Machine University

An open space at the heart of the SACMI production environment for sharing skills, work tools and
values.
Professional and human values, and over a century of technological expertise combine to produce some
of the very best professionals to be found in today’s manufacturing sector. 
In Italy and abroad.

###  

## SACMI GROUP

The SACMI Group operates globally with over 70 production, distribution and service companies
operating in 25 countries. The SACMI brand and logo are recognised and protected in over 100
countries worldwide. Through its own brands and thanks to the companies of its Global Network,
active in the five continents, SACMI distributes its products and services all over the world,
always putting customer satisfaction first.

processes. Furthermore, the investments made in recent years have made it possible to greatly reduce
the environmental impact of production activities, containing emissions into the atmosphere,
reducing water consumption and optimizing the waste management cycle.

# Precision. Performance. Partnership.

At The Alumina Company (TAC), we are building a world-class specialty alumina platform at Abu Dhabi.
Our state-of-the-art facility shall produce Specialty Aluminas across six distinct lines with a
combined annual capacity of 300,000 TPY by 2030. The first line for White Fused Alumina goes
onstream in 2026. We fulfill critical applications in refractories, abrasives, technical ceramics,
and high-technology, delivering reliability, sustainability, and innovation — every deliverable
confirming to Industry 4.0 principles and global best practices.

# Why our platform delivers

Strategically Engineered for Performance, Reliability, and Long-Term Value

# Strategic Location

KEZAD is at the nexus of dependable feedstock, global logistics and green energy. UAE domicile
mitigates impact of taxes and tariffs. Lowest cost delivered at our your plant gate.

# Full Basket Offerings

Complete specialty alumina portfolio: one stop solutions, strategic sourcing, risk diversification
—plug-in architecture for to scale up your operations.

# Advanced Automation

Best-in-class European automation programmed for cost-efficient execution, powered by Industry 4.0.
Real-time data and remote operations deliver faster response times and dependable, error-free
quality you can count on—batch after batch

# Unmatched Product Breadth at Global Scale

TAC shall produce 300,000 TPY Specialty Alumina across six lines starting with WFA now. Products on
the anvil include Calcines, BFA, Tabular Alumina, Calcium Aluminate Cement, Spinel. These lines
shall be at a single location in UAE enabling you to source the full spectrum of your specialty
alumina needs from a single, reliable partner.

## White Fused Alumina

## Specialty Calcined Alumina

## Alumina-Magnesia Spinel

# Global Industries. Critical Applications.

We empower industries worldwide with high-performance materials:

## Refractories

High-performance alumina for heat-resistant linings and industrial furnaces.

## Abrasives

Precision materials for cutting, grinding, and polishing applications.

## Technical Ceramics

Advanced alumina for durable, high-precision ceramic components.

# Specialty Alumina Is Everywhere – From Renewables To Wearables

If it’s metal, plastic, brick, or glass, it was made in a refractory system. If it’s smooth, shaped,
or finished, abrasives got it there. From dental implants to the power grid, technical ceramics are
omnipresent. Behind these—plus your phone, your watch, and the critical technologies greening our
planet—specialty alumina quietly powers it all.
[ [newImage28][newImage28] ][20]

# Green Alumina. Not just a Promise.

Our facility integrates energy-efficient systems, real-time process monitoring, and waste reduction
strategies — minimizing environmental impact while maximizing industrial performance.
[newImage21][newImage21]

# Strategic Partners. Shared Success.

TAC has secured two cornerstone long-term partnerships—EGA for feedstock supply and CREMER ERZKONTOR
for strategic sales. Building on this momentum, TAC intends to expand its network of global partners
across feedstock, technology and go-to-market channels to deliver greater reliability and value.
